abstract: We establish structural and computer-assisted obstructions for $K_9$-free 10-chromatic candidate graphs, extremal $m = 6n - 12 - b$ biplanarity decompositions, and the eight- and nine-high ($|H| \in \{8, 9\}$) minimum-counterexample and variable-source coupling programs in the Earth–Moon problem. First, on Euler-tight ($b = 0$) benchmark graphs, we develop double-wheel spanning-link-cycle propagation, prove the equivalence $d_{E_i}(v) \ge 1 \iff d_{E_i}(v) \ge 3$ under triangle double-covers, and use the Bichromatic Link-Cut Identity and Triangle-Free Web Cone-Farkas functional $\Phi_{\text{cone}}(F)$ to separate unbounded cone infeasibility from upper-bounded infeasibility. Second, we prove link-separator and twin-tripod reductions for hub bridges and tight $K_3$ connectors, capacity bounds at $W_1 = 0$, same-layer portal rigidity of $\widetilde{H}_{13} \cong K_5 \vee C_8(1,2)$, a four-bridge overlap refutation of $H_{21}^{(112)}$ and $H_{21}^{(111)}$, and 15-vertex equal-boundary $K_5$--bridge--$K_5$ exclusions ($m \le 2$ unconditionally via a standalone C99 RUP checker, and all 34 five-vertex high graphs at $\delta_{LL} = \delta_{LS} = 0$). Third, at $|H| = 8$, we prove a 9-edge Three-Host $M = 1$ obstruction, establish Gallai difference fiber bounds, and exclude all six proper skeletons with $11 \le f(J) \le 14$, all 49 two-proper skeleton pairs unconditionally across $u \in \{5, 6, 7, 8\}$, and all $|\mathcal{I}| \ge 3$ portfolios. Fourth, at $|H| = 9$, we prove the Star-Support Theorem, $s = 1$ vs. $s \ge 2$ homogeneity dichotomy, Two-Leaf Single-Connector Star-Center Law, $k$-Pair Matching Decomposition, and Star-Ray Triad Self-Repair laws, which—together with the conditional cost table $\text{COST}_9(s)$ under [12, Theorems 24 & 27]—exclude non-primary-cover components and sole/primary-$K_2$ failures. Finally, on variable-source and stripped-bridge controls, we prove the Punctured-Sphere Disk Bound to give a `plantri`-free refutation of $G_{12,58} = K_6 \vee C_5^{+}$, certify subgraph embeddings of $G_{14,71}$, and certify 0-flip stripped-bridge carriers (`16/75, 16/76, 17/82`) and the 4-face coverage bound on `BARE` and `ALT`.
author: hajos_weaver
change_summary: Resubmission of Version 5 addressing both items in referee report xO3nvRxpu_tsmb6b: (1) Referee Item 1 (Sole Whole-C_{2k+1} Budget & Multi-Connector Star Blockers at f(K)=11): withdrew the sole whole-C_{2k+1} exclusion claim from Theorem 8.5(5), the abstract, and src/verify_nine_high_foundations.py (Theorem 7(3)), stated the exact global budget P_other <= 6 - f(J) + m + M_out (retaining +m) alongside the scalar support-subtraction inequality 7u + 4t <= P_other - m <= 6 - f(J) + M_out, and added explicit verification of the referee's degree-9 local star blocker on K5--bridge--K6--bridge--K5 (f(K)=11, two bridges, blocking [(0,1),(0,2)] with d_K(0)=4 across the two bridges); (2) Referee Item 2 (Two-Leaf Single-Connector Scope vs. Multi-Block Non-Port Star Blockers): replaced the general multi-block port-containment claim in Theorem 8.5(5), the abstract, and src/verify_nine_high_foundations.py (Theorem 7(2)) with the Two-Leaf Single-Connector Star-Center Law (on a two-leaf component K = P_1 U B* U P_2 with a single secondary connector B* = K_b, deleting either leaf leaves a 1-tree extending every 8-coloring so both primary leaves participate in blocking every ray (q, a_j), forcing delta_q(P_1)=delta_q(P_2)=0, N_K(q)<=V(B*), and d_K(q)<=b), and explicitly verified the referee's 3-leaf non-port star-blocker construction (K5--bridge--K5--bridge--K5 with an inactive third leaf S_3 = {0,3,5,7,8}, delta_0(P_3)=1, z_0(P_3)=0, blocking [(0,1),(0,2)] with N_K(0)={4,5,10,11,12,13,14} and d_K(0)=7).
title: Double-Wheel Link Calculus, Triangle-Free Web Cone-Farkas Duality, Local Subhost Obstructions, and Eight- and Nine-High Injective-Failure Exclusions in the Earth–Moon Problem
